About me

Hi, I’m Logan.

I’m a graphic designer behind Miller design. I recently moved to Québec, where I’m studying computer graphics and building my career.

I have solid skills in print, from posters and layouts to catalogues, and I also design for the web. I build websites with Elementor, so I can take a project from the first sketch to a finished page.
